text:
anya: Quick sync: we're doing a cross-account backend switch + provider pin in the upcoming release window (01:00-02:30 UTC). This affects tenant-vpc and shared-network. Proposing a hard hold on merges touching `backend` and `providers`.

todd: ack. Do we need an IAM key rotation/policy change as part of the backend swap? Last time the cross-account role ARN mismatch caused locks to fail.

anya: Good catch. No key rotation in this change, but we will add a short-lived cross-account role mapping. Steps: snapshot states, create temp read-only copy of tfstate in backups, apply role mapping in staging, run plan, then swap backend key in prod.

may: Provider pin proposal: pin `hashicorp/aws = 4.12.1` for the release window only. Also suggest `required_providers` explicit in modules that touch S3/DynamoDB.

todd: +1. Who runs the plans? I can run the staging plan and upload artifacts. Will need CI to use `-state=staging.tfstate -var-file=staging.tfvars`.

anya: CI checklist I'm adding to release notes:
- run `./scripts/snapshot-states.sh` and verify S3 copy exists
- run `./scripts/verify-dynamo-lock.sh` against prod lock table
- ensure `providers.tf` is pinned in the branch
- run `terraform plan -out=staging.plan` in staging workspace
- upload `staging.plan` and `staging.plan.txt` (terraform show) to `s3://tf-plans/release-1753221111/`

may: Rollback triggers: abort apply if any of the following:
- plan contains network route deletions
- IAM role ARN replacements or creation > 2
- more than 5 resource changes in a single workspace
If triggered, follow the restore playbook: copy last snapshot back to prod key, clear locks, notify infra-oncall.

deploybot: deploybot: apply queued and blocked by merge-hold "cross-account-backend-swap". To proceed, comment `@deploybot approve cross-account-backend-swap` on this thread. Scheduled timer: 1753308000.

oncall-bot: Preflight tasks scheduled at 00:30 UTC: state-backup, provider-check, plan-diff. Failures will post alert to #eng-infra and ping on-call.

todd: For extra safety, run a no-op `apply -refresh-only` after snapshot to ensure state isn't stale. Also capture `terraform state pull > pre-apply.tfstate` and attach to S3.

anya: Good. I'm going to lock merge-hold now and tag the infra PR. Will post staging plan link once uploaded.

may: I'll be monitoring `prod:metrics/locks` and `prod:metrics/s3-error` during the apply window. If S3 errors appear, we'll stop and restore.

deploybot: deploybot: merge-hold locked by anya. To proceed after validation, tag `@deploybot approve cross-account-backend-swap`.

anya: Thank you. Please keep comments here short and include `#ops` prefix if you're adding runbook steps so I can copy them into release notes.

may: #ops Uploaded backup script snippet to PR. Will add the restore commands to runbook.

anya: Plan uploaded: s3://tf-plans/release-1753221111/staging.plan (staging.plan.txt included). Targeting final decision at 23:45 UTC tonight.
